summary_en: Yushiro executed acquisition of up to 170,000 shares (1.32% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 3,110 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on 11 November 2026, with total acquisition amount up to 528.7 million yen, to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Self-dealt Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 11 November 2026, Yushiro's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock. The company executed a purchase order at the off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3) session on 12 November 2026 at 08:45 am Japan Standard Time, fixing the purchase price at 3,110 yen per share, which was the closing price (including final special quotes) on 11 November 2026. The acquisition targeted up to 170,000 shares, representing 1.32% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of 31 October 2026 (12,814,520 shares), with a total acquisition amount not to exceed 528.7 million yen. The purchase order was valid only during the specified trading session on that day, and the results were to be disclosed after the transaction ended. The company stated that the acquisition was undertaken to improve capital efficiency and implement flexible capital policy in response to future management conditions.
